title: Decision: one-to-one rooms are ordinary unnamed rooms of two, flagged direct locally; not room-policy-04 fixed_membership (agent choice, epic mimid-qqtk)
description: Mark S2 (client-survey.md §10): a store-level direct flag. room-policy-04 §5 names fixed_membership rooms as the DM style (participants set at creation, no canAddParticipant on non-zero roles, ordinary users cannot leave, one such room per set of participants). Not used: mimid hosts a room then invites (participants are not set at creation), agent-frontends.md §7.1 makes PART a real leave, and the hub would need the uniqueness rule. Chosen: Store::open_direct hosts an unnamed room (HostOptions::named(""), default policy) and invites the user; the direct flag is local and never sent, so other providers see an ordinary room. A room first seen unnamed with exactly two participants is taken as direct (INVENTED heuristic). JMAP kind direct with contactId. Open for Mark: adopt fixed_membership (and max_users = 2) later. Doc: agent-frontends.md §7.29.
